reason: Creates fixed-size Channel Monitor V2 rollup tables and indexes for the 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day dashboard views.
risk: The migration creates normal indexes without CONCURRENTLY. If the rollup tables already contain data from a partial or manual rollout, index creation can scan and briefly lock them.
mitigation: On the normal rollout path all rollup tables are newly created and empty, all DDL is idempotent, and the bounded aggregator populates them only after migrations complete. Investigate pre-existing rollup tables before retrying a partial deployment.
